title: Evasion Attacks: How Adversarial Noise Bypasses ML Classifiers
abstract: arXiv:2610.00136v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper presents a reproducible, educational study of evasion attacks in image classification and text classification. A compact convolutional network trained on MNIST reached 98.63% clean test accuracy and was evaluated under two white-box attacks. Under FGSM, accuracy fell to 60.20% at $\epsilon$ = 0.15 and 1.72% at $\epsilon$ = 0.30; under PGD it fell to 32.47% and 0.41%, and a bit-depth-reduction defense recovered only part of the loss. In the second experiment, DistilBERT fine-tuned on the SMS Spam Collection reached 98.75% accuracy and a 94.96% F1-score, but a controlled sequence of pre-defined perturbations (character substitutions, whitespace noise, and a benign suffix) produced only modest probability shifts in most displayed examples and no flip from spam to ham. Adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent: the MNIST experiment is a clear evasion demonstration, whereas the text experiment is a controlled robus

translated_title: 逃避攻击：对抗噪声如何绕过机器学习分类器
translated_abstract: 本文对图像分类和文本分类中的逃避攻击进行了一项可复现的教学性研究。在MNIST上训练的紧凑卷积网络达到了98.63%的干净测试准确率，并在两种白盒攻击下进行了评估。在FGSM攻击下，当ε=0.15时准确率降至60.20%，当ε=0.30时降至1.72%；在PGD攻击下分别降至32.47%和0.41%，而位深缩减防御仅能恢复部分性能损失。在第二个实验中，在SMS Spam Collection数据集上微调的DistilBERT达到了98.75%的准确率和94.96%的F1分数，但一系列受控的预定义扰动（字符替换、空白噪声和良性后缀）在大多数展示的示例中仅引起了适度的概率变化，并未出现垃圾邮件到正常邮件的类别翻转。研究表明对抗脆弱性强烈依赖于数据模态：MNIST实验是一个清晰的逃避攻击演示，而文本实验则是一个受控的鲁棒性研究。
tldr: 本文通过MNIST图像分类和SMS垃圾邮件检测的可复现实验表明，对抗脆弱性强烈依赖于数据模态——图像分类器在FGSM和PGD白盒攻击下准确率从98.63%暴跌至接近0%，而文本分类器对预定义扰动表现出较强的鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: Through reproducible experiments on MNIST image classification and SMS spam detection, this paper demonstrates that adversarial vulnerability is strongly modality-dependent—image classifiers collapse under FGSM and PGD white-box attacks while the text classifier shows considerable robustness to pre-defined perturbations.
